# Auto Ontology Agents can retrieve documents and query databases, but reliability gates agentic analytics: a revenue metric answered faster is worth nothing if the number is wrong. Agents need a context layer that tells them where data lives, what it means, whether to use it, how to use it, where it came from, and what is similar. NVIDIA Auto Ontology is an open library that builds that layer from enterprise metadata, reconciles definitions across systems, and exposes it to any agent harness through MCP, CLI, and API. It complements the semantic models customers already own. It enables developers to: - Discover: generate enterprise ontologies from metadata; connect existing ontologies and semantic models; build AI-ready knowledge graphs. - Ground: give agents trusted business meaning for metrics, entities, and relationships; reconcile inconsistent definitions across systems. - Validate: check generated queries against certified definitions and lineage; return provenance with every answer. - Expose: serve context to any agent harness through MCP, CLI, and API. # T3 Code

T3 Code is an "agent harness control surface". It enables control of the agents on your machine with a best-in-class mobile app ([iOS](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/t3-code-remote-claude-more/id6787819824), [Android](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.t3tools.t3code)), [web app](https://app.t3.codes) and [Electron-based desktop app](https://t3.codes).

Works with your subscriptions on Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok Build, OpenCode, Google Antigravity, and fx. If they're set up on your computer, T3 Code can control them.

## "Wait, what are you selling me?"

Nothing. We built T3 Code because we wanted the best possible development experience with agents. We were inspired by existing solutions like the Codex desktop app, Conductor, Claude Desktop and Cursor Glass, but none met our bar.

We wanted something performant, remote-ready, and truly open. If we ever go the wrong direction, we want you to have everything you need to fork and build the editor that you want.

## Installation

> [!WARNING]
> T3 Code currently supports Codex, Claude, Cursor, Grok Build, OpenCode, Antigravity, and fx. Install and authenticate at least one provider before use:
>
> - Codex: install [Codex CLI](https://developers.openai.com/codex/cli) and run `codex login`
> - Claude: install [Claude Code](https://claude.com/product/claude-code) and run `claude auth login`
> - Cursor: install [Cursor CLI](https://cursor.com/cli) and run `agent login`
> - Grok Build: install [Grok Build CLI](https://x.ai/cli) and run `grok login`
> - OpenCode: install [OpenCode](https://opencode.ai) and run `opencode auth login`
> - Antigravity: enable it in Settings, then use **Install Antigravity** and **Sign in with Google**. No CLI is required.
> - fx: install [fx](https://fx.sh) and run `fx login` on the machine running the T3 Code server ([setup guide](./docs/user/providers-fx.md))

### Command line

```bash
curl -fsSL https://t3.codes/install.sh | sh
```

gstack turns Claude Code (and other coding agents) into a virtual engineering team: a CEO who rethinks the product, an eng manager who locks architecture, a designer who catches AI slop, a reviewer who finds production bugs, a QA lead who opens a real browser, a security officer who runs OWASP + STRIDE audits, and a release engineer who ships the PR. Fork it. Improve it. Make it yours. And if you want to hate on free open source software — you're welcome to, but I'd rather you just try it first.

**Who this is for:**
- **Founders and CEOs** — especially technical ones who still want to ship

Low-latency desktop streaming for the browser, written in Rust. voxl streams an X11

screen instead; see [macOS](#macos) and [Windows](#windows).

# Go Music DL > ⭐ 如果这个项目对你有帮助，欢迎点一个 Star。

Go Music DL 是一个多平台音乐搜索与下载工具，支持 **Web**、**TUI** 和**桌面端**，覆盖单曲、歌单、专辑、排行榜与本地音乐。它同时暴露了一套 AI 可调用的接口——**AI 可以直接操控你正开着的网页播放器**，点歌、切歌、暂停、调音量都不用你动手，详见 [AI / Agent 调用](#ai--agent-调用)。 ## 🚀 快速开始 ### 桌面端 / 移动端 从 [Releases](https://github.com/guohuiyuan/go-music-dl/releases) 下载对应安装包： - Windows / Linux / macOS：从 Releases 下载 `music-dl-desktop-rust` 或 `music-dl-desktop-go` 对应平台包，解压后直接运行。 - Android：优先下载 `music-dl_arm64-v8a.apk`，已内置 FFmpeg，无需额外安装。 - iOS：使用 `music-dl-ios-unsigned.ipa` 自行签名。 ### Web / TUI ```bash # Web，默认访问 http://localhost:8080/music ./music-dl web # 挂载到反向代理二级目录 ./music-dl web --base-path /dl # 终端搜索 ./music-dl -k "周杰伦" ``` Web 的搜索、试听、下载和歌单浏览无需登录；修改设置或 Cookie 时才需要管理员账号。首次配置时，启动日志会打印 `Web setup token`，用它创建管理员账号即可。TUI 常用键：`↑/↓` 移动、`空格` 选择、`a` 全选、`r` 换源、`Enter` 下载、`w` 每日推荐、`q` 退出。 ### Docker ```bash docker compose up -d --pull always --remove-orphans ``` 访问 `http://localhost:8080`。首次启动会自动创建 `./data` 并配置好容器写权限；Compose 不依赖仓库里的 Dockerfile 或其他文件，只需 `docker-compose.yml` 和镜像即可启动。修改源码后可使用 `docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d --build` 本地构建。 ### AI / Agent 调用 Web 服务提供 AI 能力索引和播放器控制接口。搜索、歌单、专辑、排行榜、歌单分类、换源、歌词、下载和本地音乐等能力全部复用现有的 `/music/*` 接口，不再维护第二套 AI 包装路由。 ```bash # 搜索歌曲，只请求 QQ 和网易云 curl "http://localhost:8080/music/search?q=周杰伦&type=song&sources=qq&sources=netease" ``` API 索引：`http://localhost:8080/music/api/ai/index`，精简说明：`http://localhost:8080/music/llms.txt`。索引会列出可直接复用的现有搜索、详情、排行榜、歌单分类、换源、下载和本地音乐接口，以及新增的播放器控制接口。 #### AI 可以直接操控网页播放器 只要浏览器里开着本站页面，AI 就能**远程操作这个页面**：点歌、切歌、暂停、调音量、拖动进度，全部靠一条 HTTP 请求完成。不需要浏览器自动化、不需要模拟点击、也不需要接管你的鼠标键盘。 原理是页面自己维持着一条 SSE 长连接（`GET /music/api/ai/player/events`）：AI 把命令 POST 到服务端，服务端推给在线的页面，页面执行后把播放状态回传。所以 AI 看到的 `playing`、`position`、`current` 都是页面的真实状态，而不是猜测。 典型对话：**“帮我放一首 ClariS 的歌”** → AI 调 `/music/search` 找歌 → 调 `/api/ai/player/play` 点播 → 轮询 `/api/ai/play

readme_excerpt:
LZ4 - Extremely fast compression
================================

LZ4 is a lossless compression algorithm,
providing compression speed > 500 MB/s per core,
scalable with multi-core CPUs.
It features an extremely fast decoder,
with speed in multiple GB/s per core,
typically reaching RAM speed limits on multi-core systems.

Compression speed can be tuned dynamically, by selecting an "acceleration" factor
which trades compression ratio for faster speed.
On the other end, a high compression derivative, LZ4_HC, is also provided,
trading CPU time for improved compression ratio.
All versions feature the same decompression speed.

LZ4 is also compatible with [dictionary compression](https://github.com/facebook/zstd#the-case-for-small-data-compression),
both at [API](lib/lz4frame.h) and [CLI](programs/lz4.1.md#operation-modifiers) (`-D`) levels.
It can ingest any input file as dictionary, though only the final 64 KB are used.
This capability can be combined with the [Zstandard Dictionary Builder](https://github.com/facebook/zstd/blob/dev/programs/zstd.1.md#dictionary-builder),
in order to drastically improve compression performance on small files.

The LZ4 library is provided as open-source software using the BSD 2-Clause license.
The `lz4` command line utility is provided under the GPL-2.0-or-later license.

Benchmarks
-------------------------

The benchmark uses [lzbench] v2.4.1, from @inikep
compiled with GCC v13.3.0 on Linux 64-bits (Ubuntu 24.04).
The reference system uses a Core i7-9700K CPU.
Benchmark evaluates the compression of reference [Silesia Corpus]
in single-thread mode.

[lzbench]: https://github.com/inikep/lzbench
[Silesia Corpus]: https://sun.aei.polsl.pl/~sdeor/index.php?page=silesia

# Gemini API skills

A library of skills for the Gemini API, SDK and model interactions.

## About

LLMs have fixed knowledge, being trained at a specific point in time. Software
dev is fast paced and changes often, where new libraries are launched every day
and best practices evolve quickly.

This leaves a knowledge gap that language models can't solve on their own. For
example, models don't know about themselves when they're trained, and they
aren't necessarily aware of subtle changes in best practices (like [thought
circulation](https://aistudio.google.com/docs/thought-signatures.md)) or SDK

[Skills](https://agentskills.io/) are a lightweight technique for adding
relevant context to your agents. This repo contains skills related to building
apps powered by the Gemini API.

generate correct API code following best practices to 87% with Gemini 3 Flash
and 96% with Gemini 3.1 Pro. For more details, see our blog post:

# NVIDIA Kubernetes Engine (NVKE)

[![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-Apache--2.0-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![Go](https://img.shields.io/badge/Go-1.27.3-00ADD8.svg)](go.work)

**Run a managed Kubernetes service on your own NVIDIA GPU infrastructure.**
NVIDIA Kubernetes® Engine (NVKE) provides the management plane that platform teams install to create and
operate Kubernetes clusters for their customers. Each workload cluster has its
own Kubernetes control plane, etcd and node pools. You operate the NVKE management
plane; your customers use their clusters through the Kubernetes API and `kubectl`.

> **Preview:** NVKE is available as a preview. APIs, configuration and behavior
> can change between releases, and we do not recommend NVKE for production
> workloads. See [Preview status and known limitations](docs/overview/preview-status.md).

[Get started](#getting-started) · [Documentation](docs/README.md) ·
[Contribute](CONTRIBUTING.md) · [Get help](SUPPORT.md)

## Getting started

| Your goal | Start here | What you get |
|---|---|---|
| **Evaluate without GPU hardware** | [Local quickstart](docs/get-started/quickstart-local.md) | A development management plane and a workload cluster on simulated machines. No NVIDIA account is required. |
| **Install on your infrastructure** | [Plan your installation](docs/operate/plan-installation.md) | The prerequisites and sequence for preparing nodes, bootstrapping a management cluster and installing its services. |
| **Build or contribute** | [Build from source](#build-from-source) | The NVKE binaries and the contributor development loop. |

The local quickstart runs on a **Linux host or VM, amd64 or arm64**, with at least
**6 CPUs, 12 GiB of free memory and 100 GiB of free disk**. It requires Docker,
virtual TPM support and the tools listed in the guide. Follow its setup through
workload-cluster creation and confirm the cluster's nodes report `Ready`.

# Kubernetes controller-runtime Project

The Kubernetes controller-runtime Project is a set of go libraries for building
Controllers. It is leveraged by [Kubebuilder](https://book.kubebuilder.io/) and
[Operator SDK](https://github.com/operator-framework/operator-sdk). Both are
a great place to start for new projects. See
[Kubebuilder's Quick Start](https://book.kubebuilder.io/quick-start.html) to
see how it can be used.

Documentation:

- [Package overview](https://pkg.go.dev/sigs.k8s.io/controller-runtime/pkg)
- [Basic controller using builder](https://pkg.go.dev/sigs.k8s.io/controller-runtime/pkg/builder#example-Builder)
- [Creating a manager](https://pkg.go.dev/sigs.k8s.io/controller-runtime/pkg/manager#example-New)
- [Creating a controller](https://pkg.go.dev/sigs.k8s.io/controller-runtime/pkg/controller#example-New)
- [Examples](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/controller-runtime/blob/main/examples)
- [Designs](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/controller-runtime/blob/main/designs)

# Versioning, Maintenance, and Compatibility

The full documentation can be found at [VERSIONING.md](VERSIONING.md), but TL;DR:

Users:

- We stick to a zero major version
- We publish a minor version for each Kubernetes minor release and allow breaking changes between minor versions
- We publish patch versions as needed and we don't allow breaking changes in them

Contributors:

- All code PR must be labeled with :bug: (patch fixes), :sparkles: (backwards-compatible features), or :warning: (breaking changes)
- Breaking changes will find their way into the next major release, other changes will go into an semi-immediate patch or minor release
- For a quick PR template suggesting the right information, use one of these
